3152.title: Nested command disclosure remains collapsed
3152.rootCauseOneLine: The expanded timeline body mounts a second command disclosure whose independent state starts collapsed with a two-line clamp.
3152.proposedFix: Render the mounted command as a non-interactive full block while retaining the existing maximum-height overflow behavior.
3152.caveats: Live reproduction used the repository demo server with fixture-only command data; the focused failure was repeated in two clean trusted checkouts.
